name: 7 Wonders

categories.label: Military conflict tokens
categories.hint: Sum of conflict tokens: +1 (Age I), +3 (Age II), +5 (Age III) per victory, -1 per defeat. Can be negative.

categories.label: Coins in treasury
categories.hint: Enter total coins; every 3 coins = 1 VP (rounded down).

categories.label: Wonder stages
categories.hint: VP printed on each built wonder stage (stages that give other effects score 0).

categories.label: Civilian structures (blue)
categories.hint: Sum of VP on blue cards.

categories.label: Scientific structures (green)
categories.hint: Count each symbol: each symbol type scores n squared, plus 7 per complete set of all three.

formula.expr: compass ** 2 + gear ** 2 + tablet ** 2 + 7 * min(compass, gear, tablet)

categories.label: Commercial structures (yellow)
categories.hint: Sum of VP from yellow cards (mainly Age III; includes card-based coin/VP effects).

categories.label: Guilds (purple)
categories.hint: Sum of VP from guilds, per card text (your city and/or neighbours).

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Official rulebook PDF could not be downloaded (mirror blocked); scoring order and values cross-checked from two rules summaries. Leaders/Cities/Armada expansions and Babel/Edifice not modelled. Tiebreaker coin count uses coins before conversion (enter coins in the coins field).
